meta: MVP development for startups: product scoping, web and mobile MVPs, scalable architecture and security from day one, with SOC 2 readiness when you need it.
h1: From idea to a secure MVP, ready for your first customers and investors
lead: We help founders build the first version of their product quickly, without the security shortcuts that cause problems when the first enterprise customer or investor looks closely.

items.p: We agree what goes into the first version, so you launch sooner and spend less.
A working product your first customers can use, on web, mobile or both.
A cloud setup that handles your first users and scales when you need it.
User accounts, subscriptions and connections to the tools you rely on.
Assistants, search and automation where they make the product better.

blocks.lead: Fixing security later is slower and more expensive than building it in.

items: Security basics that pass early customer reviews
SOC 2 readiness when enterprise customers ask

items.p: An agreed first version with a clear price and timeline.
Engineers who keep building your product, month to month.
Updates, fixes, monitoring and security patches.

blocks.text: Already selling to larger customers? See our enterprise and SaaS solutions for SOC 2, single sign-on and security reviews.

blocks.lead: Something missing? Ask on the consultation call and we will answer it straight.
items: How long does an MVP take?
It depends on scope. After a short discovery phase we agree what goes into the first version and give you a timeline and a fixed price.
Will we need to rebuild it later?
Not if it is planned well. We keep the first version small but build it on an architecture that can grow, so you extend it instead of starting over.

items.p: Secure SaaS products, ready for SOC 2 and customer security reviews.
Portals, dashboards and business systems on .NET and Angular.
Manual testing with a report your developers and auditors can use.
